title: [Red Skies, Wares]
description: The low-ceilinged cabin is lit by a swaying oil lantern, the smoky light casting sharp shadows across a pair of crossed cutlasses ornamenting the stern wall.  A broad mistwood table bolted to the floor dominates the center, strewn with curled charts, navigational tools, and a half-drained bottle of rum.  Crimson drapes frame the expansive, salt-stained windows, while a bed constructed of oak and rope lies tucked behind a curtain of faded sailcloth.
